---
title: "Sprott R System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& 1+ay\\
\dot{y} &=& 1+z\\
\dot{z} &=& xy-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.52$ and initial condition $(-1,-3,3)$.
